title: chat-push: two unspecified cases
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-push-00.md: (1) ~L108 does not say whether a chatPush entry for an account without the capability is rejected (with which error) or ignored. (2) A single ChatMessagePush entry that exceeds the platform payload limit even alone has no defined handling; the StateChange fallback is allowed only for rate limiting. Found by the 2026-10-20 guide alignment pass.
close_reason: chatPush without capability -> invalidProperties; oversized entry: shorten/drop snippet (SHOULD), then StateChange.
